description: Core Infrastructure - Create CDS integration module for auto-inclusion in cds test, template files for scaffolding, and configuration files (jest.config.js, .eslintrc.js, .npmignore). This feature establishes the foundation for the package.
steps: 1. Create lib/cds-integration.js - A CDS service integration module that hooks into cds.test to auto-run MBT tests. Export a MbtService class with init(), run() methods. Use cds.log('mbt') for debug output. Follow the pattern in cds-plugin.js for CDS integration.

2. Create templates/machines/agent-orchestrator.machine.js - Template machine for agent orchestration based on lib/machines/index.js createAgentMachine pattern. Include states: idle, planning, executing, synthesizing, completed, escalated. Include proper context with llmCallsUsed, retryCount, toolResults.
3. Create templates/machines/workflow.machine.js - Template machine for workflows based on createWorkflowMachine pattern. Include dynamic step generation, approval states, retry logic.

4. Create templates/machines/migration.machine.js - Template machine for data migration based on createMigrationMachine pattern. Include states: idle, extracting, transforming, loading, verifying, committing, rollingBack, completed, failed.

5. Create templates/invariants/agent.invariants.js - Template invariants for agents. Export budgetRespected, retriesBounded, noInvalidCompletion, escalationHasReason. Follow the pattern in lib/invariants/index.js.
6. Create templates/invariants/workflow.invariants.js - Template invariants for workflows. Include stepOrderMaintained, noSkippedRequiredSteps, approvalRequired invariants.
7. Create templates/invariants/migration.invariants.js - Template invariants for migrations. Include dataConsistent, rollbackAvailable, noPartialCommit invariants.
8. Create templates/agent.mbt.test.js - Jest test template for agent MBT tests. Follow the pattern in lib/cli/init.js getTestTemplate().
9. Create templates/workflow.mbt.test.js - Jest test template for workflow MBT tests.
10. Create templates/migration.mbt.test.js - Jest test template for migration MBT tests.
11. Create jest.config.js - Standard Jest configuration with testMatch for **/*.test.js, coverage thresholds at 80%, collectCoverageFrom lib/**/*.js.
12. Create .eslintrc.js - ESLint configuration for ES6+, Node.js environment, with rules matching existing code style (semicolons required, single quotes).
13. Create .npmignore - Exclude test/, examples/, .github/, *.test.js, coverage/, .eslintrc.js, jest.config.js from npm publish.
14. Update lib/index.js - Add exports for the new joule and tla modules (require placeholders that will be implemented in FEAT-002 and FEAT-003).
15. Update package.json - Add 'examples/' to files array, ensure all dependencies are correct.
acceptance_criteria: lib/cds-integration.js exports MbtService class with init() and run() methods
All 9 template files exist in templates/ folder with valid JavaScript
jest.config.js configures Jest properly for the project
.eslintrc.js provides ESLint rules matching existing code style
.npmignore excludes test and dev files from npm publish
npm test passes (even if tests are minimal at this stage)
verification: Run: node -e "require('./templates/machines/agent-orchestrator.machine')" - should export a valid XState machine
Run: node -e "require('./templates/invariants/agent.invariants')" - should export invariants with .all array
